verdict.rationale: Fastmail has automations in the form of Filters & Rules, so versioning and rolling them back is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack, however, contains only page titles for that feature. Nothing documents version history, change review, or rollback for rules. Undo send is a different capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
